note: Small Black Hills NF campground on the north side of Deerfield Reservoir, about 23 mi west of Hill City via Deerfield Rd and FSR 417: five drive-in RV pull-offs in a row beside the road, looking across a grass flat to the lake, plus walk-in tent sites. Boat launch (no-wake lake), Deerfield Lake Loop trailhead, vault toilet and drinking water in season. Dark skies. Off season it stays open without services on an unplowed road. Distinct from Dutchman and Whitetail. --Claude
